title: Checkout
heading: Checkout
subheading: Complete your order and we'll bring it fresh to your door.
summaryLine: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · ₹{amount, number}
deliveryUnavailableBody: We couldn't get a delivery price for this address just now. Nothing has been charged — please try again in a few minutes.
cartChangedBody: Something in your cart is no longer on sale. Review your cart before paying.
closedBody: Online payment is not switched on yet. Nothing has been ordered and nothing has been charged, and your cart stays saved.
noAddressBody: Tell us where to deliver. We'll save it to your account, so you only type it once.
noDeliverableBody: Fresh greens are delivered only in selected areas, and none of your saved addresses is in one. Add one that is, or remove the greens from your cart to ship the rest by courier.
payNote: You pay on Cashfree's secure screen. We never see your card or UPI details.

errors.paymentsClosed: Online payment is not switched on yet.
errors.cartChanged: Something in your cart changed. Review it and try again.
errors.priceChanged: A price changed since you opened this page. Check the new total and pay again.
errors.deliveryUnavailable: We couldn't price delivery to this address just now. Nothing has been charged — please try again shortly.
errors.gatewayError: We couldn't open the payment screen. Please try again in a moment.
errors.notCompleted: The payment was not completed. Your cart is still here, so you can try again.
errors.deliveryChanged: Delivery prices changed since you checked. We've looked again — pick a delivery partner and pay.

addressLimit: You have {max, number} saved addresses, the most we keep. Remove one in your account to add another.
partnerLocked: Confirm your address and we'll compare delivery partners for it.
scanningBody: Asking each delivery partner for today's price to your address.
scanned: Compared {count, plural, one {# partner} other {# partners}} and picked the cheapest.
ownRunBody: Your order has fresh greens, so we bring it ourselves rather than by courier.
showOthers: {count, plural, one {See # other partner} other {See # other partners}}
readyToShip: Handed to the courier {date} — the arrival date follows the delivery partner
pickupNote: We take a day to pack your order and hand it to the courier on {date}. Each arrival date counts from then.
